FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Caring Medical Supplies operates as a retail medical supply store dedicated to providing high-quality, FDA-approved medical equipment and supplies to healthcare providers, patients, and caregivers. Our operations encompass a diverse range of products including mobility aids, wound care supplies, personal protective equipment, and home health care items. We emphasize safety and compliance, ensuring that all products meet regulatory standards and undergo rigorous quality checks. Our store is designed with customer safety in mind, featuring well-lit aisles, clear signage, and organized displays to enhance the shopping experience. Our knowledgeable staff is trained in customer assistance and equipment usage, allowing us to support customers effectively and provide proper instructions for equipment operation. Furthermore, we have a proactive loss control program, conducting regular safety audits and equipment maintenance to uphold the highest standards of operation and ensure a safe shopping environment for our customers.
